form.title: Your child's details
form.ageMonthsHint: Use this only if you do not know the date of birth.
form.positionHint: Children under 2 years are usually measured lying down. Older children are measured standing.
rf.oedema: Is there swelling of both feet?
rf.weak: Is the child very weak, not feeding, or unusually sleepy?
rf.loss: Has the child lost weight recently?
urgent.title: See a health worker today
urgent.body: You answered yes to a warning sign. These signs can be serious, whatever the measurements show. Do not wait.
urgent.sign.weak: Very weak, not feeding, or unusually sleepy
remeasure.title: Measure again
remeasure.body: At least one number looks unlikely. This is often a measuring or typing mistake. Check what you entered, then measure again.
remeasure.how: How to measure: under 2 years, lay the child flat and measure length. From 2 years, stand the child straight without shoes and measure height. Weigh with little or no clothing.
result.title: Result
measure.title: What the measurement shows
measure.note: This compares your child with the WHO Child Growth Standards. It is not a diagnosis.
ind.wfa.q: Is the weight usual for this age?
ind.lhfa.q: Is the length or height usual for this age?
ind.wflh.q: Is the weight usual for this length or height?
band.risk_overweight: A little above the usual range
status.implausible: This result looks unlikely, so it is not shown as a band. Measure again and check the numbers.
status.not_applicable: No result for this check. The number is outside the range covered by the WHO table.
msg.wfa.severely_low: Your child's weight is far below what is usual for this age. This can have many causes, and the measurement alone does not say why. A health worker can look at your child and explain.
msg.wfa.low: Your child's weight is below what is usual for this age. Many children are measured here, and the measurement alone does not say why. Mention it to a health worker.
msg.wfa.normal: Your child's weight is in the usual range for this age.
msg.lhfa.severely_low: Your child's length or height is far below what is usual for this age. This can have many causes, and the measurement alone does not say why. A health worker can look at your child and explain.
msg.lhfa.low: Your child's length or height is below what is usual for this age. Many children are measured here, and the measurement alone does not say why. Mention it to a health worker.
msg.lhfa.normal: Your child's length or height is in the usual range for this age.
msg.wflh.severely_low: Your child's weight is far below what is usual for their length or height. This can have many causes, and the measurement alone does not say why. A health worker can look at your child and explain.
msg.wflh.low: Your child's weight is below what is usual for their length or height. Many children are measured here, and the measurement alone does not say why. Mention it to a health worker.
msg.wflh.normal: Your child's weight is in the usual range for their length or height.
msg.wflh.risk_overweight: Your child's weight is a little above what is usual for their length or height. Many children are measured here. Mention it to a health worker at a regular visit.
msg.wflh.overweight: Your child's weight is above what is usual for their length or height. The measurement alone does not say why. Mention it to a health worker.
msg.wflh.obesity: Your child's weight is far above what is usual for their length or height. The measurement alone does not say why. A health worker can look at your child and explain.
meaning.title: What this means
see.title: When to see a health worker
meaning.urgent: You answered yes to a warning sign. That matters more than the numbers shown above.
meaning.see_soon: At least one measurement is far from the usual range. The measurement alone does not say why. A health worker can look at your child and explain.
see.see_soon: Please arrange to see a health worker soon. Ask them when to come back.
meaning.check: At least one measurement is a little outside the usual range. Many children are measured here. A health worker can follow your child's growth over time.
see.check: Mention this to a health worker. Ask them when to come back.
meaning.routine: The measurements are in the usual range for this age.
see.routine: Keep going to regular health visits. See a health worker any time you are worried or your child seems unwell.
meaning.routine_remeasure: The numbers that could be checked are in the usual range, but at least one number looks unlikely. This result is not complete.
see.routine_remeasure: Measure again. See a health worker any time you are worried or your child seems unwell.
calc.title: How this was calculated
calc.intro: Every number comes from the WHO tables and a fixed formula. No AI is used to calculate anything.
calc.adjust.plus: Your child is under 2 years old (730 days or fewer) but was measured standing. WHO length is measured lying down, so 0.7 cm is added.
calc.adjust.minus: Your child is 2 years or older (731 days or more) but was measured lying down. WHO height is measured standing, so 0.7 cm is subtracted.
calc.adjust.none: No adjustment: the way your child was measured matches the WHO standard for this age.
calc.zHelp: z-score: how many steps your child is from the middle of the WHO standard. Zero is the middle.
calc.percentileHelp: Percentile: out of 100 children in the WHO standard, about this many measure lower.
err.position: Choose how your child was measured.
err.age_missing: Enter the date of birth or the age in months.
err.age_range: This check is for children from birth up to 5 years old. Check the date of birth or the age.
err.visit_before_dob: The measurement date is before the date of birth. Check both dates.
err.weight_range: Weight should be between 0.9 and 58 kg. Check the number.
err.length_range: Length or height should be between 38 and 150 cm. Check the number.
footer.text: Uses WHO Child Growth Standards (2006). Not a diagnosis. Nothing you enter is stored.
footer.repo: Data sources and download dates: data/who/SOURCE.md in the repository.
calc.without: Without this correction, length-for-age would read
calc.without.changed: The correction changes the result to: {band}. Measuring the right way matters.
